messages:
Isha R: quick sync: ops asked for a minimum-safe plan to deprecate v1 route-by-route without surprising billing. idea: preview mode vs live move.
Ben C: preview mode should not touch quotas or billing. runs sampled simulation and shows CI. live move does gradual weight shift with pause/revert hooks.
Liam O: telemetry: add tags deprecation_mode=preview|gradual|live and cohort=control|shadow|optin. expose p95 delta, regression_rate, and est_cost_delta.
Maya V: console UX: banner includes "Preview" CTA that launches a preview job (1%/5% sample). modal shows estimated cost +/- CI and top prompts (redacted).
Isha R: ops rule: if regression_rate > 2% for 15m or p95 delta > 50ms -> auto-pause transition and notify owner. ops-bot will open incident.
Ben C: API: PATCH /routes/{id}/deprecation {mode, sample_pct, transition_minutes}. response returns job_id when preview launched.
Liam O: note: do not count preview samples toward hard quotas. include preview_quota_estimate metric for tenant planning.
Maya V: assign: Liam -> metric names & tags PR, Ben -> router sampling prototype, Isha -> runbook draft and console copy. aim for alpha behind flag in 2w.
ops-bot: NOTE: audit event route.deprecation.change emitted on every state transition.
Isha R: thanks all, i'll add issues and link here. end.
